title: WPPIL/222/2021 of HARISH PANERU Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (PIL) No. 222 of 2021
Harish Paneru. .................Petitioner.

-Versus-State of Uttarakhand
and others. .........Respondents.
Present:
Shri Shakti Singh, Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Pradeep Joshi, Addl. CSC for the State of Uttarakhand.
Shri Rajendra Dobhal, Sr. Advocate assisted by Shri Shubhang Dobhal, Advocate for the respondent
no. 2.
Shri Vipul Sharma, Advocate for respondent no. 4.
Date of hearing and order: 29.12.2021
Coram:
Sri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, ACJ.
Sri Narayan Singh Dhanik, J.
Upon hearing the learned counsel for the parties, the Court made
following order (Per Sri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, ACJ)
1. In this writ petition, the petitioner has prayed for the
following reliefs:
"i. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Mandamus
directing the concerned respondents to take necessary steps
with regard to the construction of residential purposes for
the employees / teachers / officers of the G.B.Pant
Agriculture and Technical University Pant Nagar, District
- Udham Singh Nagar (as mentioned in Annexure No. 2, 3
and 5 of the writ petition);
ii. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus
directing to the concern respondents to take necessary steps
on the representation made by the petitioner to various
officials, via emails and couriers."

2
2. The aforesaid prayers do not fall within the ambit of Public
Interest Litigation. Therefore, writ petition is dismissed as not
maintainable.
 (Narayan Singh Dhanik, J.) (Sanjaya Kumar Mishra)
 Acting Chief Justice.
SKS
